preservedResponsibilities: Original compile-time string flag constants and mask macros are bound in a dependency-free header fragment so C implementation reexports cannot change static-empty initialization order. Source values and bitwise signedness are unchanged; byte specialization and original Unicode ownership tests exercise the shared macros. Native pointer/thread ABI remains unverified.
omittedResponsibilities: Native raw pointer/thread/atomic ABI and the rest of the private header are owned separately.

filenameDivergence.rationale: The original compile-time strimp.hxx flag macros form a dependency-free ESM fragment so reexported C implementation owners cannot run before static-empty flag constants are initialized. The private declaration header still reexports the same bindings, and writable allocation globals retain their separate strimp.cxx owner.
